chromatin_interaction_failures.meaning: Actual located chromatin input, capture, calculation or delivery failures, with their specific missing requirements.

chromatin_interaction_projection.meaning: Exactly requested chromatin measurements, populations, denominators and qualifications; heuristic values retain their meaning.

chromatin_interaction_saved_sheets.meaning: Explicitly returned numerical sheet and complete table identities for later selected recalculation; no access to unrequested child outputs.

committed_record_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by completed own work and completed child investigations.

credit.meaning: Projected credit at child completion for its fixed assigned scope; redelivery preserves that snapshot.

episode_yield.meaning: Recorded closing local numerical forecast and continuation decision, in the child's configured controller units. It is not task credit, a job ETA, a parent instruction or goal completion. Null when the controller does not expose the supported typed numerical state. Normal status is 0; -1 means insufficient observations and -2 means unidentifiable, not negative predicted gain.

completed_actions.description: Completed own actions at this child's level; an investigation commissioned by it counts once.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

execution_protein_structure_failures.meaning: Recorded structured protein result failure with original identity; no model-authored finding.

execution_protein_structure_projections.meaning: Exactly selected protein structure values or an exact selected-table descriptor; equality is checked against the original result record.

execution_protein_structure_saved_sheets.meaning: Original saved numerical-sheet descriptor with explicitly granted uses; descriptor receipt is not receipt of unselected values.

execution_protein_structure_sequences.meaning: Original structure-derived sequence descriptor and explicit downstream uses; original record equality and authority are checked separately.

interpretation_basis_refs.meaning: Semantic references visible to the last admitted report interpretation response and available at this report boundary, including source-window custody and admitted typed forms. A visible handle does not establish that its full record or source body was read.

last_outcome_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by the last completed own ordinary action.

observations_after_report_basis.meaning: Last ordinary-action observations not supplied to that interpretation response.

pending_handles.meaning: Original selected child executions still pending when this episode closed. These handles survive parent closure; closure does not cancel them or establish scientific completion.

subject_refs.meaning: Original input subjects assigned by the parent.

alias.description: Bare local definition name, for example role (not @role). Reference this successful row in the same commit as @role; use its returned persistent ID in later commits.

anyOf.description: An exact half-open UTF-8 byte interval of this retained artifact. quote.encode("utf-8") must equal artifact_bytes[start:end], including punctuation. A source.read window already supplies start, end and text: use that complete text as quote with those unchanged offsets, or select a smaller read window. Character indices and a cropped quote do not determine new byte offsets.

artifact_ref.description: An existing persistent record ID. In a reasoning commit only, @name refers to an earlier successfully processed row declared with alias name in this same commit. Ordinary tool calls require existing persistent IDs.

source_ref.description: An existing persistent record ID. In a reasoning commit only, @name refers to an earlier successfully processed row declared with alias name in this same commit. Ordinary tool calls require existing persistent IDs.

label.description: Literal label occurring in the anchored quote, e.g. DUF8182. Do not compose DUF8182 (Pfam PF26554) unless that complete text occurs in the quote. Extraction preserves a source assertion, not its biological truth.

source_ref.description: An existing persistent record ID. In a reasoning commit only, @name refers to an earlier successfully processed row declared with alias name in this same commit. Ordinary tool calls require existing persistent IDs.

term_type.description: Preserve the source's classification category: a protein domain or homologous superfamily is distinct from a family and from a molecular activity. These categories do not establish target membership or function.

goal.description: A substantive improvement the child can pursue iteratively and revise from outcomes. A fully specified one-off lookup/calculation belongs to an ordinary tool. Numerical yield controls the child's continuation.

initial_report_json.description: JSON containing exactly the interpretation fields you chose (those without x-source), with parent-supplied initial values. Use {} for the fact-only example; for the interpretive example use {"interpreted_assessment_refs":[],"unresolved_hypothesis_refs":[]}. Those initial arrays are not new child judgments. If you request other interpreted fields, define their allowed meanings and initialize them explicitly. The runtime does not choose fields or unknown values for you.

purpose.description: Explain what information you need for your later scientific decision and what your selected form fields mean.

schema_json.description: JSON encoding of your parent-defined closed return form: explicit required fields, additionalProperties false, typed arrays, and strings restricted to enum codes or declared semantic formats. A reference can declare format reference and x-reference-namespace. child_tool_info.instructions: For HIC binary version 9, supply a null group_path, an existing BP resolution, and exact biological chromosome names. Select raw contacts or an existing named divisive normalization vector. The All pseudochromosome, FRAG units and other HIC versions are not supported by this binding. A missing matrix, unread block or absent normalization remains unavailable; it is not an empty matrix. Native expected-value vectors are retained as source metadata and are not used as the requested same-population distance expectation. Supply an authorized retained contact container, its complete file identity and actual format, and exact cis population intervals in selected order. Select cis_anchor_contact_enrichment, cross_window_insulation_heuristic, or both. For contacts, supply retained BED occurrences with explicit enhancer/promoter/other assignments, interval-start or supplied in-interval anchors, and actual reference/sample/condition/replicate/dependence information when available. Names never determine element class or gene associations. No candidate annotation or public gene name is required. Bind exact input keys/identities/paths, selected Python interpreter and dependency/source byte pins. The binding compiler supplies the driver command and exact output paths under output_prefix. Commission launch and its configured launch_local child with 20 GiB RAM, 4 GiB scratch, zero swap, and no wall-time budget. The local child owns preparation, practical.job.start, observation and any later repair choices through the ordinary episode. The finite producer validates immutable supplied bytes and uses the selected format's parser for each population, closes its exact canonical tables and population seal, then advances in selected order. It retains the full container, BED, supplied metadata, sparse rows/source locators, bins, selected weights and exceptional cells; absent roles and failed reads remain explicit. It performs no mapping or balancing. No raw fallback, smaller region, first-chromosome choice, fabricated zero matrix, resource substitution or retry is performed. Monitoring uses the existing local resource instructions and actual lifecycle/log/population-seal facts; liveness establishes no productive progress. Earlier closed population seals survive a later interruption. Results captures complete files and separately builds the numerical sheet and calculations from retained tables. Same-distance expectation uses the exact selected region, not an inferred whole chromosome. Fold is undefined when its denominator is zero; count zero remains distinct from missing data. Duplicate element occurrences remain separate, dependent comparisons. Insulation includes every full cross-window, retains its cell denominator and standardized sum, and uses explicit strict-neighbor/threshold rules. Folds and boundaries are descriptive heuristics, not probabilities or significance tests. Request the specific typed projection needed by the parent, retaining complete components and sheet/table bundle separately. Changed calculation parameters use the saved bundle only; missing saved attachments never trigger native rereading or acquisition. Capture extent, native execution outcome, numerical qualification, requested delivery and credit/completion remain distinct.

evidence_axis.investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions the supplied gene or protein may perform by comparing its sequence with relevant homologs and family profiles. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets. No candidate annotation or searchable public name is required. Preserve the selected material and its boundaries; do not infer a complete sequence from snippets or choose an arbitrary record from a multi-record file.

Use the comparisons to identify plausible families and distinguish their functions. Examine what was experimentally characterized in relevant homologs, including close relatives with different functions, and map the features bearing on those differences to the supplied target. Retain the identity of the experimentally studied subject separately from the sequence or profile used in a search. A database description or inherited family label is not experimental characterization.

Retain actual alignment or profile scores, bit scores, E-values, identity, matched spans and coverage when available, with the method, search space, score units, denominators and reported uncertainty or bounds. Keep query and comparator coverage distinct, and distinguish a matched domain from the whole protein. Compare numbers only where their methods and scales permit the comparison; a sequence score is not a probability of a particular function.

Examine catalytic and recognition residues, missing or additional domains, and substitutions or insertions that distinguish possible activities. High overall identity can coexist with different substrate specificity; a short match or conserved cofactor-binding region can support only a broader conclusion. Preserve negative results, function-changing differences and unresolved regions. Revise the possible functions as the comparisons become informative, keeping family membership, exact reaction, substrate specificity and physiological role distinct.
evidence_axis.name: Sequence homology

thought_pattern.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.
thought_pattern.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
thought_pattern.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.
Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.
Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

thought_pattern.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

Generic native results mean requested current-filesystem acquisition plus independently observed successful exact execution, without a producing-attempt or atomic-version claim. RNA results mean complete requested original-bundle or retained-sheet delivery, including specific unavailable values; this does not assert native success. Yielding alone is false.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

execution_blast_hsps.meaning: Optional explicitly requested native measurements for all published HSPs of this acquired result. No automatic ranking, top-N or significance filter. target_coverage is native reference/hit coverage, not original gene-target coverage. HSP/reference records support later scoped reads; selected HSP references can instead be returned through a parent-chosen typed field. No functional assignment or annotation score.

execution_bvbrc_counts.meaning: Native matching-document counts with their exact population and availability.

execution_bvbrc_expression_rows.meaning: Selected molecular measurements with recorded result, bioset, experiment and feature relationships.

execution_bvbrc_facets.meaning: Native field buckets and saved fractions of the same response's exact document population.

execution_bvbrc_feature_sequence_rows.meaning: Selected feature occurrences and their recorded AA/NA sequence associations.

execution_bvbrc_numeric_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native rows, numerical measurements and source metadata cells.

execution_bvbrc_pages.meaning: Selected retained response and page coverage; document counts are acquisition metadata.

execution_completed.meaning: Whether this assignment has actual verified endpoint information. Generic native results mean requested current-filesystem acquisition plus independently observed successful exact execution, without a producing-attempt or atomic-version claim. RNA results mean complete requested original-bundle or retained-sheet delivery, including specific unavailable values; this does not assert native success. Yielding alone is false.

execution_handoff_refs.meaning: Qualified original handoff sources actually available to this episode, including authenticated original failed native database or RNA attempts for partial-output acquisition; failed attempts do not establish a successful native endpoint.

execution_hmmalign_sequence_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_hmmer_domain_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_nhmmer_locus_rows.meaning: Explicitly selected native numerical rows with exact source and observation bindings. Unbound rows are measurements without an invented biological subject; unavailable values are not zero. Native occurrences and dependent rounds retain their original meanings. No annotation score.

strand.description: Native strand '+' projects to plus and '-' projects to minus; null means strand was not applicable or unavailable. Native symbols remain in retained sheets.

execution_result_origin.meaning: Actual acquisition semantics: current-file windows or a complete digest-verified original BLAST/HMMER/Infernal/RNA producer bundle. RNA failed native attempts and saved-sheet recalculations return null even when qualified delivery completes.

execution_result_refs.meaning: Qualified actual requested result acquisitions available to this episode. Generic native windows retain current-filesystem observations. Explicit BLAST/HMMER/Infernal/RNA producer bundles retain original attempt outputs matched by digest and requested numerical facts. RNA source delivery alone grants no auxiliary artifacts or unrequested rows.

interpretation_basis_refs.meaning: Semantic references visible to the last admitted report interpretation response and available at this report boundary, including source-window custody and admitted typed forms. A visible handle does not establish that its full record or source body was read.

last_outcome_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by the last completed own ordinary action.

observations_after_report_basis.meaning: Last ordinary-action observations not supplied to that interpretation response.

pending_handles.meaning: Original selected child executions still pending when this episode closed. These handles survive parent closure; closure does not cancel them or establish scientific completion.

practical_completed.meaning: Whether this exact practical assignment has a persisted verified endpoint proof.

practical_receipt_digests.meaning: Canonical digests of this episode's original completed action receipts.

practical_receipt_refs.meaning: Scoped immutable Store sources containing original action, validation and outcome records.

subject_refs.meaning: Original input subjects assigned by the parent.

goal.objective: Execute the exact supplied HIC request on the configured local resource.

task_context.root_objective: Measure the supplied synthetic HIC contacts for E-P and E-Q in the declared populations and retain numerical qualifications.

context.report_lifecycle: Interpretations are the last actual reasoning basis; later tool outcomes are facts, not a new judgment.
context.requested_report_purpose: Return the requested typed facts with their original numerical meanings and custody.

scientific_child_credit_binding.meaning: Caller-injected projector; no default scientific policy or denominator is inferred.
